missing_information_behavior: If any required safety or context information is missing, do not add positive recommendation score; request clarification or escalate.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer serum deficiency or prescribe high doses from sunlight/diet questionnaire alone; account for fortified foods and existing supplements.
professional_escalation_conditions: Hypercalcemia, kidney disease/stones, granulomatous disease, pregnancy, malabsorption or high-dose use require clinician review.
population_and_context: People with both low sunlight exposure and low dietary vitamin D sources; risk context only, not diagnosis of deficiency.
dose_constraints: No individualized dose from this rule; use age- and jurisdiction-appropriate intake references and laboratory assessment when indicated.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin D fact sheet; serum 25(OH)D is the status marker; evidence and screening indications vary. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
